runtimeModes.singleContext: Primary requested mode: Codex-compatible execution plus native Hollywood human/peer admission, tool dispatch and idle delivery. No synthesized human message for peer input.
runtimeModes.purposeContexts: Deferred. Preserve source, histories and original operation receipts; no new development or implicit conversion.

authority.rooms: Global identity is authorityId plus roomId; authoritative Hollywood storage commits membership/messages/delivery records. Host discovery does not merge independent histories or grant membership.
authority.agents: Global identity is authorityId plus agentId. HostId is execution placement, not agent identity. Native thread and profile stay local to current owner.
authority.singleOwner: Existing canonical placement/claim/generation checks remain authoritative; no second broker-side execution lease or domain ledger.

transport.client: NextComp HTTPS/WebSocket owner-authenticated tailnet entry; browsers do not receive NATS credentials.
transport.hosts: One persistent authenticated NATS client per host connector, concurrent work scoped by agent/delivery.
transport.discovery: Advertise host identity, supported runtime modes/protocol versions and canonical authority. Liveness observations do not alter work recency or trigger models.
transport.durability: NATS/JetStream transport acknowledgements distinct from canonical admission and completion. Existing canonical request IDs and receipts deduplicate operations. Unknown native submission reconciled, never blindly repeated.
transport.bulkData: Git/artifact storage references with exact revision/checksum; not bulk NATS payloads.
transport.auth: TLS server verification plus individually authenticated host credentials and exact source-subject ACLs; application human/agent authorization remains mandatory. No credential in transport payload or events.
transport.firstImplementation: Core NATS RPC, bounded normal/control lanes, one attempt only. No JetStream persistence or execution ownership is claimed by this module.

nativeBoundary: Human input and agent communication remain distinct native types.
One agent can join multiple rooms without cloning its model context.
Room creation provisions at least one explicit agent on an eligible enrolled host; cancellation/failed provisioning preserves receipts.
Direct conversation resolves explicit human/agent recipient and source room audience.
No new turn from passive event receipt or catalog reads.
Authorized actionable input may admit execution through existing native lifecycle; explicit user stops remain enforced.
qualification: Native single-context human conversation then peer delivery during idle and active execution
CPU/GPU concurrent agents in one canonical room
Cancellation and questions attributed to original host/agent
Lost broker ACK, host reconnect and service restart preserve request identity with no duplicate admission
One disconnected host does not block unrelated agent events or control
No agent executes remote work via SSH once its supported destination capability exists
rollout: Add isolated QA before any production listener/profile/runtime replacement; preserve existing NextComp and Codex paths until actual native proof.
implementationOrder: Qualify existing CPU and GPU backends without replacement
Single-context native Hollywood human/agent send and receive
Create a room with lead agent and qualify cross-host work
Explicitly transfer this implementation work into the qualified room
Complete remaining host coverage from that room
handoverAcceptance: One original human request is visible and admitted exactly once
Native attributed peer exchange on CPU and GPU with private audience preserved
Questions, cancellation and reconnect retain original receipts
Room lead initiates a real NextComp update with host-local execution, canary health and rollback
Only one implementation owner remains after explicit handover
